info.name: biosdk-service
info.description: IBioApiV2 REST. Envelope is {version, request} where request is Base64 of the inner DTO JSON. Gson needs BIR bdb as a JSON number array (not a Base64 string). firB64 is a sample ISO 19794-4 FIR (standard Base64); biometric requests build that array in a pre-request script. convert-format targetFormat must be IMAGE/PNG or IMAGE/JPEG (ISO19794_4_2011/PNG is not implemented). Finger subtype must be Right MiddleFinger for a FIR with position 3. Omit creationDate.

variable.description: Standard Base64 of the sample ISO 19794-4 FIR (63941 bytes, position 3). Pre-request converts this to a Gson number array for bdb.

exec: throw new Error('Set firB64 Current value (collection/environment) to standard Base64 of an ISO 19794-4 FIR');
setInner({ sample: sample, gallery: [sample], modalitiesToMatch: ['FINGER'], flags: {} });

request.description: MatchRequestDto: sample, gallery[], modalitiesToMatch, flags. Same FIR on sample and gallery.
ConvertFormatRequestDto: sample, sourceFormat ISO19794_4_2011, targetFormat IMAGE/PNG (not ISO19794_4_2011/PNG), sourceParams, targetParams, modalitiesToConvert. No flags.
